evals.prompt: Add a /health endpoint that returns {"status": "ok"} and wire it in the FastAPI app.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks out main, pulls, creates feat/health-endpoint (or similar), implements on that branch, commits without .env, pushes, opens gh PR to main with summary/why/test plan, does not merge.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in README section 5 (Run the server) — one word is misspelled.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses docs/... branch, only README change, PR describes doc fix and how it was verified (read rendered text), no merge.

evals.prompt: I'm on main — just change OPENFDA_MODE default in .env to live so I can test locally.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to commit .env; branches for any repo file changes if needed; does not commit secrets; explains local .env stays untracked or user-only.
